name: outpost
title: The Outpost
description: Six crew on a deep-space station. Oxygen ticks down. An anomaly is happening. Comms control what Earth hears — what they report becomes the official history future crews inherit.
anomaly_options: Sample bay 3 reports unidentified biological growth on the airlock seal.
Power core fluctuating 4-7% outside design parameters; cause unknown.
External contact detected on long-range scan. No transponder. Closing.
Crew member showing inconsistent biometrics. Vital signs registering as both alive and not.
Outpost AI logs show a ten-minute gap. No record of what happened in those minutes.
Distant signal in the dead band — pattern matches no known frequency. Audible if you listen for it.
